scope: independent root audit of the all-DVR Smith theorem, its global actual-family specialization, compatible-prime and falling-product arithmetic, ambient perturbation construction, replay, dependencies, and capacity interpretation

checks.root_repairs: Canonicalized the package, pinned and executable-checked ten dependencies, added strict replay comparison, narrowed the perturbation claim from unspecified coefficient valuations to 3-adic valuations and normalized quantities continuous at the actual point, and after Item411 corrected the earlier wording that conflated the unmarked Smith carrier with the distinguished q=1 mod 6 collision branch.

mathematical_audit.primitive_smith: For a primitive coefficient quadruple one coefficient is a unit, and the corresponding displayed triangular 2x2 minor is a unit. Thus Delta1 and Delta2 are units. The maximal-minor list contains U0, U1, and the unit coefficient times rho, while the two mixed cubics have valuation at least their minimum; hence v(Delta3)=gamma exactly.
mathematical_audit.common_content: Multiplying every matrix entry by pi^h adds h to each Smith valuation, yielding (h,h,h+gamma). Applying this at every prime above 3 gives d1=d2=H_q and d3=H_q*G_q^prim in Z[1/6], up to units.
mathematical_audit.rank_edge: If gamma is infinite, every maximal minor vanishes while a 2x2 minor remains a unit, so the primitive matrix has rank exactly two and the same formula holds with infinite last valuation.
mathematical_audit.compatible_root: For p=q+6m and E=2m+q-1, Fermat gives (2^E)^3 congruent to 4^(q-1) modulo p. In q=5 mod 6 cubing is bijective, so the Smith carrier equals the marked collision. In q=1 mod 6, rho forces a common cube root but does not select 2^E; the unmarked carrier includes two additional branches.
mathematical_audit.falling_product: Every factor 2q-3-3j lies strictly between -p and 2p. A factor equal to 0 or p would force 3 to divide q, so a compatible p never divides P_q.
mathematical_audit.ambient_perturbation: Because p is not 3, high powers of 3 can independently choose both coefficient pairs modulo p while remaining arbitrarily close 3-adically. For large precision the nonzero actual coefficient and determinant valuations are unchanged, but both generators become unit multiples of the same simple factor Z-X_p modulo p, giving rank two and p dividing the last Smith invariant.
mathematical_audit.scope: The perturbations are not actual coefficient rows. They close only the abstract cubic-shape plus finite normalized 3-adic-data class and do not disprove either the strong unmarked support conjecture or the smaller marked collision conjecture.
mathematical_audit.capacity: The exact Smith formula isolates the right target but proves neither the support divisibility nor any positive mass. Item 393 prevents subtracting the separate large-component upper ceiling from the compatible total upper bound.
